rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for something astonishing, surprising, or shocking.

example.english: The improvement in his exam results is startling.
example.traditional: 佢今次考試嘅成績進步得好驚人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 ge3 sing4 zik1 zeon3 bou6 dak1 hou2 ging1 jan4

rows.note: Choose this when the startling thing is alarming or frightening rather than merely surprising.

example.english: The scenes in this horror film are really startling.
example.traditional: 呢套恐怖片啲畫面真係好嚇人。
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 hung2 bou3 pin3 di1 waa2 min2 zan1 hai6 hou2 haak3 jan4

rows.note: Use this for the less forceful sense of being unexpected or surprising.

example.english: It’s quite startling that you finished moving so quickly.
example.traditional: 你咁快就搬完屋，真係幾意外喎。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 faai3 zau6 bun1 jyun4 uk1 zan1 hai6 gei2 ji3 ngoi6 wo3
